description: Presents the user with a choice between 2 to 4 options, each with a label and a one-line description, one optionally marked recommended. It is for decisions where reasonable options would build different things — which widget kind, what score ranges, what copy or trigger — and nothing the user said settles it. It changes nothing and returns the options for the user to answer.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
